WHY_THIS_IS_FROZEN_FIRST: the oracle audit showed a single universal module-score reader is scientifically invalid for B4, C1, C2 and C3, and that graph recovery is not a module quantity at all. Defining those statistics AFTER seeing the deciding rebuild would be fitting the measurement to the outcome. They are therefore fixed here, with their thresholds, before the rebuild runs.
UNIVERSAL_LABEL_ON_EVERY_CEILING: every number produced under this freeze is an ORACLE CEILING UNDER KNOWN SUPPORT. The design matrix is built from the planted module_address_sets, i.e. from truth, so it measures recoverability GIVEN PERFECT MODULE DISCOVERY. It is an upper bound and must never be reported as a blind achievable ceiling for a model that has to discover modules itself.

DEFAULT_READER.features: one CPM-log1p mean per planted module from module_address_sets
DEFAULT_READER.rationale: p/n is 0.019 at 37 modules and 2,000 cells; 41,238 free regressors would give p>>n
DEFAULT_READER.estimator: OLS with a 50/50 held-out split, seed 20261005; R2 on the held-out half
DEFAULT_READER.B3_and_E2_exception: average precision against the held-out label, not R2, because these are rare or categorical

COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.estimand: the transient BAND value, band(t) = exp(-((t-0.5)/0.15)^2), NOT pseudotime t
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.estimator: OLS on held-out half; report R2(band) as the component result and R2(t) only as a diagnostic
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.pass_criterion: R2(band) within the Phase 4 designed range 0.25 to 0.45
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.threshold_provenance: the 0.25-0.45 range was set prospectively in the Phase 4 spec, before any B4 measurement existed
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.required_off_or_null_twin: a world with B4 disabled, identical seeds
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.off_twin_expected_behaviour: R2(band) must fall below 0.05 in the off twin
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.PRIOR_OBSERVATION_DISCLOSURE: a 2,000-cell smoke measurement of R2(band)=0.3551 and R2(t)=-0.0329 was observed during the oracle audit before this freeze. The threshold is NOT derived from it; it is the pre-existing Phase 4 range. Disclosed so the freeze is not presented as blind.

COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.estimand: the GAP between full recoverability of A*B and what an additive summary of A and B supplies
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.sufficient_statistic: planted module scores, plus the two fitted additive predictions pA and pB
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.estimator: gap = R2(A*B | module scores) - R2(A*B | [pA,pB]); both on the same held-out half
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.threshold_provenance: the 0.05 gap threshold was set before the first C1 measurement at 96 features
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.required_off_or_null_twin: a world with C1 disabled, identical seeds
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.off_twin_expected_behaviour: gap must fall below 0.01 in the off twin
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.PRIOR_OBSERVATION_DISCLOSURE: gap measured 0.0021 then 0.0150 at 96 features and 0.0776 at full scale in the smoke world, all before this freeze. The threshold is unchanged from its original value.

COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.estimand: z_gain, the per-cell multiplicative gain on one module's loading
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.sufficient_statistic: the C2_local module score ms, the drive z_global[:,0], and the RATIO features [ms, drive, ms*drive, ms/clip(drive,0.25)]
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.estimator: OLS on held-out half; report both the linear-over-module-scores R2 and the ratio-feature R2
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.pass_criterion: ratio-feature R2 within the Phase 4 designed range 0.40 to 0.60, AND ratio R2 minus linear R2 > 0.05
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.threshold_provenance: the 0.40-0.60 range was set prospectively in the Phase 4 spec
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.required_off_or_null_twin: a world with C2 disabled, identical seeds
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.off_twin_expected_behaviour: ratio-feature R2 must fall below 0.05 in the off twin
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.PRIOR_OBSERVATION_DISCLOSURE: measured 0.0089 global and 0.0536 conditional at 96 features, and 0.1175 linear versus 0.1590 ratio in the full-scale smoke world. ALL ARE FAR BELOW the designed 0.40-0.60 band. This freeze therefore PREDICTS C2 WILL FAIL its designed class even with the correct statistic, and the band is deliberately NOT moved.

COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.estimand: the magnitude of coupling between biological state and measurement quality
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.sufficient_statistic: library size and support count per cell; this is NOT a module quantity
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.estimator: absolute Pearson correlation of z_bioqc with library size and with support count; report the maximum of the two
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.pass_criterion: max |corr| > 0.05, against the World A reference of 0.0086
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.threshold_provenance: the 0.05 threshold was set before the first C3 measurement
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.required_off_or_null_twin: a world with C3 disabled, identical seeds
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.off_twin_expected_behaviour: max |corr| must fall below 0.02 in the off twin, i.e. back to the World A level
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.PRIOR_OBSERVATION_DISCLOSURE: measured 0.603 at 96 features, then 0.0988 at full scale after the S124 repair.

COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.estimand: recovery of the planted directed TF -> region -> target-gene graph, as a ranking problem over region-gene pairs
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.sufficient_statistic: the planted graph's known positives, versus known negatives formed from decoy regions, unbound regions and never-targeted genes
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.estimator: average precision of the scored pairs against the known-positive label, plus the separate decoy rejection rate
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.pass_criterion: average precision at least 3x the positive base rate, AND decoy regions must not score above bound regions on average
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.threshold_provenance: NOT YET MEASURED ANYWHERE. This threshold is genuinely blind and is the only one in this freeze with no prior observation.
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.required_off_or_null_twin: the decoy regions and never-targeted genes already built into the graph serve as the internal negative control; no separate off twin is required
COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_STATISTICS.off_twin_expected_behaviour: decoys must not be preferentially scored; a method that ranks decoys with bound regions fails

OFF_AND_NULL_TWIN_REQUIREMENT.rule: every component-specific statistic must be shown to DETECT its planted signal and to REJECT the corresponding off twin at identical seeds. A statistic that fires in the off twin is measuring something other than the planted component.

already_available_without_new_worlds.E2_null_arm: the NULL perturbation arm is assigned and dosed exactly like a real arm and has no effect; it is the built-in false-positive control
already_available_without_new_worlds.B3_non_recoverable_arms: arms 2 and 3 are routed out of RNA entirely and must score at the base rate
already_available_without_new_worlds.D1_decoys: decoy regions are accessible and TF-correlated but regulate nothing

OFF_AND_NULL_TWIN_REQUIREMENT.construction: the same --components selection with the one component removed, identical seed 7302

WHAT_A_CONTRADICTION_MEANS: if a measured recoverability class contradicts the prospectively designed class, that is a SIMULATOR CONSTRUCTION FAILURE. It is repaired or the component is withdrawn. It is never explained away, and no threshold in this freeze is widened after the fact.
EXPLICITLY_NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_FREEZE: any JEPA representation comparison or model evaluation
treating any ceiling as a blind achievable bound
